veto_items.question: Is there no traceable source for the candidate?
Is the candidate supported only by D-tier sources?
Can the candidate not be grounded in any task or application scenario?
Is this only a solution or technology slogan without a capability gap?
Does this exceed public-source, high-level analysis boundaries?

check_items.question: Is the capability gap or new capability space clear?
Can the evidence be traced back to source material?
Is the candidate more than a generic trend?
Is the candidate more than a technology hotspot?
Have existing solutions and residual gaps been checked?
Is the minimum evidence rule met, with at least one non-C source supporting the core claim?
Does this report require focused human sensitive review because it includes equipment form, parameter/index statements, model-synthesized solution assumptions, or high-uncertainty high-impact claims?
Does every cited EvidenceCard semantically support the candidate demand?
Is the report core conclusion supported by direct evidence or independent partial evidence with a reasoning chain?
Is adjacent evidence limited to background instead of being used as core support?
Are unassessed or weak evidence items downgraded into rework, risks, or open questions?
